text:
maria: Heads-up — we just got notification that RMA#R-20971 will arrive as two shipments from vendor A and vendor B. Vendor A can ship 6 H100s from EU pool by air (ETA 4 business days) but wants to split AWBs due to customs; Vendor B can push 4 H100s but only via sea (ETA ~12 business days). 
jin (vendor): Confirmed. For the 6 air units we can consolidate to one AWB but it raises brokerage/duty exposure; we proposed two AWBs to keep values under local thresholds. AWB: `EU1234567890` for the first batch, `EU1234567891` for the second. Sea units will go from CN port -> NL crossdock, then truck. 
lucas: Any chance we can prioritize firmware-matched units? Last time we had a mismatch and had to return 2 because of BIOS revision. We need firmware build >= `v2.3.1` to avoid rework. 
jin (vendor): Noted. The air batch are pre-checked at depot and show `v2.3.2` on the manifest. Sea units are `v2.2.x` — we can apply FW update at the NL crossdock but it adds ~24–36h and a 150 per-unit handling fee. 
ashley: From procurement: what's the delta if we push everything air and expedite? We have flexibility in the PO to accept a one-time expedite surcharge vs a credit note. Please give firm numbers. 
jin (vendor): Air-for-all expedite would be +2,300/unit door-to-door (includes uplift and prioritized manifest), lead time 3 business days. Sea-to-air upgrade for the 4 sea units is +2,600/unit (crossdock CPU/time). If you accept a partial credit instead of replacement for the sea units, we can issue a 70% credit and immediately reserve replacement units from our EU reserve pool (subject to allocation). 
maria: If we do EU reserve pool, can you commit allocation for Q2 (min 10 units) or is that subject to sell-through? We really need stable SLA for Dedicated fleet. 
jin (vendor): We can commit a 10-unit hold for Q2 with a 60% deposit; remainder invoiced at shipment. However that hold excludes blackout windows during vendor maintenance weeks (we'll flag calendar dates). 
lucas: Also confirm serial mapping — will we get complete serial list before shipping? Need to pre-burn host keys and staging config. 
jin (vendor): Yes, we'll share full manifest 24h before pickup. We'll also provide test logs where available. 
rma-bot: Ticket RMA-20971 created and linked -> https://rma.example.com/R-20971 (status: pending-split). 
maria: Ok — action items: 1) jin to confirm EU reserve pool dates and provide deposit invoice; 2) jin to send final manifests (serials + FW) 24h prior; 3) vendor to provide cost delta for air-all vs mixed with exact AWB numbers; 4) procurement (ashley) to ok deposit if numbers align. Will reconvene once manifests arrive. :thumbsup:
